prerequisites: It is recommended to have passed the courses from previous semesters.

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
SOS2 - Competence in the sustainable use of resources and in the prevention of negative impacts on the natural and social environment.
SOS4 - Competence in the application of ethical principles related to sustainability values in personal and professional behavior.
Ability to apply knowledge in practice.
Ability to work in a team.
Aptitude for oral and written communication in the native language.
Capacity for autonomous and deep learning.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity, critical reasoning, and to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills, and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering.
Capacity for adaptation to new situations.
Creativity and inventive spirit in solving scientific-technical problems.
Knowledge for carrying out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert opinions, studies, reports, work plans, and other similar tasks.
Attitude of motivation for quality and continuous improvement.
Provides the tools to maintain equipment and components in optimal operating conditions, as well as for the analysis and development of their maintenance systems.

syllabus_topics: Theme 2: Organization and planning of maintenance in industry.
The maintenance service in the company's organizational chart
Internal organization of the maintenance service
Types of industry according to the production process flow
Establishment of the maintenance policy according to the type of industry
Level of preventive maintenance to apply
Maintenance control and management through indicators
Maintenance indicators according to UNE-EN 15341 standard
Warehouse stock management for spare parts
The UNE-EN 13460: 2009 Documents for Maintenance standard
Theme 6: Methods and techniques for the design of production system maintenance
teaching_methods: Theoretical development of the course program.
Development of practical sessions, seminars, and problems according to the program.
Development of practical activities related to the subject in the theoretical part. Mandatory attendance at laboratory practices is required.
Reviews of subjects and/or questions that may be necessary.
assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of two deliverable tests, each accounting for 10% of the total grade, and a final exam accounting for up to 80%. The final exam is split 50% for the part taught by the Electrical Engineering Department and 50% for the part taught by the Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineering Department. The evaluation of ODS included in the learning outcomes will be included.
